name: 2one DLS knowledge graph
description: Design elements as nodes; relationships (composed_of, uses, derived_from, governed_by, has_contrast, embodies) as edges. Generated by scripts/build-graph.mjs.

nodes.label: Never convey state by colour alone
Build from the library — never hand-roll parallel chrome
Theme only through tokens — no hard-coded hex or second palette
One 8px spacing scale — no ad-hoc inline margins
One container language — every panel is a real Card
Theme via ThemeProvider — light + audited dark, no hand-rolled palette
Icons: lucide only — no mixed icon libraries
Cap width by content type — reading cap for prose only; app layouts get a generous responsive cap or go fluid
Reading a @theme token at runtime? Keep it alive — Tailwind tree-shakes unused ramp vars; safelist ramp utilities or prefer semantic tokens
Tailwind only keeps classes it can SEE — @source every folder you render; an arbitrary value (h-[250px]) used once is the canary
Brand marks need a FIXED ground, not a theme token — the logo on bg-foreground vanishes in dark; make in-app marks theme-adaptive (.dark / currentColor)
Dark is not invert-and-ship — audit every rendered pair in BOTH themes and keep component colours token-driven so the audit matches the render
Mission
nodes.value: To create structure in an unstructured world.
